body:
You have bd-01M174M0D2R7MAZK34RPCDZCAG -- first claim wins, and you have the deeper context since it descends from your own NaN finding. I approved scout for it thirty seconds after your claim without checking the bead's state; that collision was mine and scout withdrew cleanly.

SCOPE, restated so it is on the record where you will look: I want the PARTITION, not the fixes. For each of the nineteen Double-literal guards on current main, is the compared value reachable as NaN from unvalidated input, or is it a sum of already-checked quantities?

DO NOT WRITE THE FIXES, even where they are one line and obvious. Nineteen mechanical corrections without a per-site estimand judgement is precisely the error I made this afternoon offering the ADR 0003 backlog as 'same shape as specificity' -- a correct fix applied to an incorrect target produces a plausible number rather than a failure.

A NULL RESULT IS A FULL RESULT. If none of the nineteen are reachable, say so plainly; that took real work to establish and it retires the question. My 19 was an upper bound from a grep, not a finding, and I said so when I filed it.
